list.snippet: Lobectomy: Removal of a lobe of the lung (most common).
Wedge resection/Segmentectomy: Removal of part of a lobe.
Pneumonectomy: Removal of the entire lung.
Surgery is often used for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer.
Uses high-energy X-rays to kill cancer cells.
Can be used as the main treatment, before or after surgery, or with chemotherapy.
External beam radiation: Delivers radiation to the lung and surrounding areas.
IMRT: Radiation beams are shaped to match the tumor, with intensity changes during treatment.
